messages:
mina: quick note while onboarding voyager-v1 int8: found a deterministic detok flip for corner quotes when CJK follows an Arabic (RTL) fragment. float32 is fine. posting minimal repro.

lee: please paste the exact prompt + tokenizer + whether this is repro on local and staging.

mina: model=voyager-v1 (int8 qk-1), tokenizer=voyager-sp. repros on local int8 and staging canary. float32 decode unchanged.

mina: repro (copy/paste):
```
Prompt: Translate to zh: "He said \"Good morning\" in Arabic: \u0635\u0628\u0627\u062d \u0627\u0644\u062e\u064a\u0631"
# expected snippet: \u4ed6\u8bf4\uff1a\u300e\u65e9\u4e0a\u597d\u300f
# actual (int8):    \u4ed6\u8bf4\uff1a\u300f\u65e9\u4e0a\u597d\u300e  <-- corner quotes swapped
```

toby: if token ids roundtrip correctly then this smells like a detok table or fused-detok kernel that reorders codepoints under bidi. have you tried alternate detok tables?

mina: yes. switching to detok_table_v2 on int8 fixes it. table_v3 + detok_fuse_v2 combo triggers the flip. ids around the quotes match float32.

lee: any chrF/BLEU impact in smoke tests?

mina: ci-smoke (200 mixed-locale samples) shows chrF drop 0.782 -> 0.718; failures concentrated on CJK-with-RTL group. artifact at /runs/1768954321/voyager-int8-smoke.

yusuf: starting bisect on detok_fuse_v2 and detok_table commits. smallest failing sample would make automated bisect easier.

mina: smallest failing input I found: "\u0635\u0628\u0627\u062d \u0627\u0644\u062e\u064a\u0631 \u2018\u65e9\u4e0a\u597d\u2019" (Arabic + single CJK quoted phrase). only with that ordering quotes flip. gist with full repro: https://gist.github.com/mina/voyager-cjk-bidi-repro

yusuf: bisect result: detok_fuse_v2 commit 4f2c9a5 introduced a conditional reorder when has_rtl=true. reverting that commit locally removes the flip. opening PR to revert + add unit test for mixed-orientation quoted phrases.

lee: nice find. add a regression test to translation-regressions that covers mixed-orientation quotes and a token->char roundtrip check for both float32 and int8.

sasha: tagging @eng-runtime and infra. plan: hotfix (force table_v2 when has_rtl) -> canary -> revert commit and proper unit-tests -> staged rollout.

infra-bot: canary deploy started: voyager-int8-hotfix -> ppool-2 at 1768954800

mina: testing canary now. will rerun minimal repro + 200-sample smoke in ~10m and report back.

infra-bot: canary deploy complete at 1768955100

mina: canary check: minimal repro fixed, chrF back to 0.781 on smoke. tentative hotfix looks good.

yusuf: PR opened (yusuf/revert-detok-reorder). adding unit tests to token-diff-suite and translation-regressions.

lee: please link PR and ticket. we'll run full evals before rolling to prod. thanks all. :thumbsup:
